verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a built-in Copilot at app.skyvern.com. Users describe a job in plain English and Copilot builds an agent they can test, edit, schedule and share, and Copilot chat also helps build and debug workflows interactively. The core product likewise takes a natural-language goal and carries it out in a browser. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of Copilot's capabilities and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Copilot assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe the job to Copilot at app.skyvern.com. It builds an agent you can test, edit in Studio, schedule and share. No code.
Copilot chat for building and debugging workflows interactively
SOP upload — describe a process in plain English and Skyvern builds the workflow
